source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
Take detailed notes of all failed items.
3. Include the date and time of inspection.
4. Identify the location of the failed items within the building.
5. Clearly describe each issue.
6. Provide photographs or sketches if possible.
7. Include any relevant codes or standards that were not met.
8. Note any immediate hazards and potential safety risks.
9. Document any discussions with building owners or managers regarding the failed items.
10. Include recommendations for rectification or repair.
11. Detail any non-compliance with local or national regulations.
12. Finish with a summary overview.
13. Sign and date the report to validate it.
14. Submit the report to the appropriate authorities.<|end_of_text|>
